components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with warm rust earth background and pill shape
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a86132; color: #fff7ed; padding: 0.6875rem 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: all 200ms ease; box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px var(--shadow-color-dark), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 12%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.03); box-shadow: 3px 3px 10px var(--shadow-color-dark), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 15%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); filter: brightness(0.98); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 6px var(--shadow-color-dark), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 10%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #a86132, 0 0 0 4px rgba(168, 97, 50, 0.2); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Tactile card surface with neumorphic elevation
components.css: .ds-card { background: #eceae2; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 2px 2px 8px var(--shadow-color-dark), -2px -2px 4px var(--shadow-color-light); transition: box-shadow 250ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 4px 4px 14px var(--shadow-color-dark), -3px -3px 8px var(--shadow-color-light); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Inset surface input with pill shape
components.css: .ds-input { background: #e3dfd5; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); border-radius: 9999px; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #2e2a25; outline: none; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 6px var(--shadow-color-dark), inset -2px -2px 4px var(--shadow-color-light); transition: all 200ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #82796d; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 6px var(--shadow-color-dark), inset -2px -2px 4px var(--shadow-color-light), 0 0 0 2px rgba(168, 97, 50, 0.5); }

narrative.overview: Revaro embraces a warm, tactile neumorphic aesthetic that feels like a familiar space rather than a sterile interface. Drawing from the comforting textures of handcrafted goods and well-worn furniture, the design creates an environment that encourages the sharing economy - where pre-loved items feel valued and transactions feel neighborly. The palette is built around warm beiges and earthy tones, creating a soft backdrop that never competes with product imagery. Subtle raised and inset surfaces add physicality through depth, using light and shadow to suggest real materials rather than flat digital planes.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile & Human: Neumorphic surfaces create a sense of physical depth that feels approachable and warm
Earthy & Grounded: A warm beige palette with natural accent tones creates a calming, neighborly atmosphere
Subtly Expressive: Depth and elevation communicate hierarchy without harsh contrast or aggressive colors
Product-First: The soft backdrop ensures product imagery and content remain the focal point
Light/Dark Aware: Both themes maintain the same warm character, adjusted for comfort in different lighting conditions

rules.name: The Soft Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text never relies on pure black or stark white. Every foreground color is softened to reduce eye fatigue while maintaining WCAG-compliant readability.

rules.name: The Warm Inversion Rule
rules.body: Dark mode doesn't flip to cold grays - it deepens the warm palette with near-black browns and amber-tinted highlights, preserving the brand's hearth-like character.

rules.name: The Breathing Room Rule
rules.body: Body text maintains a comfortable line height of 1.5 to support extended reading without fatigue.

rules.name: The Physical Light Rule
rules.body: All shadows simulate a consistent top-left light source. The dual-shadow approach (inner light edge, outer dark edge) models real-world surface relief.

rules.name: The Subtly Lifted Rule
rules.body: Elevation changes are incremental and purposeful. Cards lift just one rung on hover - enough to feel responsive without feeling cartoonish.

rules.name: The Soft Edge Rule
rules.body: Harsh 90-degree corners are avoided entirely. Every interactive surface uses a generous radius that contributes to the overall sense of warmth and tactility.

rules.name: The Tactile Affordance Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements must feel pressable. This is achieved through elevation changes on hover/active states, never through color alone.

rules.name: The One System Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, chips, and badges share the pill shape language. This consistency reinforces the friendly, unified character across every surface.

dos: Do embrace the neumorphic depth - it's core to Revaro's warm, human character
Do preserve the warm palette in dark mode rather than inverting to cold grays
Do use incremental elevation changes (rest → hover → active) to communicate interactivity
Do keep product imagery as the hero - the soft background and subtle surfaces are designed to recede
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by providing static fallbacks for animated elements
Do maintain soft contrast ratios using the muted foreground colors rather than pure black/white
donts: Don't use harsh, high-contrast shadows or pure white highlights that create a glow effect
Don't introduce cold blues, stark grays, or neon colors that would break the earthy warmth
Don't flatten the interface - the tactile depth is a deliberate brand differentiator
Don't rely on color alone to indicate state; use elevation, shadows, and rings for clarity
Don't use sharp rectangular corners - the soft pill and large-radius language is integral to the character
Don't override the elevation system with ad-hoc box-shadows that don't respect the dual-light-source model
